summary.title: MongoDB Command Reference & Query Operations
mechanisms_and_formulas: Context switching mechanism: `use database_name` changes the active database session.
Collection lifecycle mechanism: `db.createCollection('name')` initializes a new collection, while `db.collection.drop()` removes it.
Data insertion mechanism: `db.collection.insertOne(document)` adds a single document to the specified collection.
summary.factual_summary_text:
The material provides a cheatsheet for fundamental MongoDB command-line operations, focusing on database and collection management. It defines the syntax for switching between databases using the `use` command and listing available databases with `show dbs`. Additionally, it covers the lifecycle of collections, including creation via `db.createCollection()` and deletion via the `.drop()` method.

The content also introduces basic CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) query operations, specifically highlighting the insertion of data. It demonstrates how to insert a single document into a collection using the `insertOne` method, providing a concrete example of inserting a user object with name and age fields. This serves as a foundational reference for executing standard MongoDB shell commands.
